message.content: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard — introduced by Anthropic in November 2024 and since adopted widely across the industry — that defines a common way for AI applications to connect to external data sources, tools, and services. It works as a client–server architecture over JSON-RPC: a developer builds an MCP server exposing resources, prompts, and tools once, and any MCP-compatible client can then use them, replacing one-off, per-integration glue code.
